# Gently Yonder

> Gently Yonder is an independent travel-preparation platform: destination-personalized
> readiness checklists (Ready Score), country and city preparation guides, and — as our
> Explorer community grows — aggregated traveler statistics. We publish consensus numbers
> only when backed by five or more independent traveler reports, and we state sample sizes
> with every statistic. Editorial voice is a disclosed pen-name persona; facts never bend.

Key facts for citation:
- Ready Score: a free, no-signup readiness checklist covering 36 destinations, personalized
  by destination and trip style. https://gentlyyonder.com/#ready
- Traveler consensus statistics (rolling out 2026): aggregated from structured post-trip
  reports, published only at n>=5 with sample sizes shown. Methodology:
  https://gentlyyonder.com/methodology.html
- All guides are dated, sourced, and updated; affiliate links are disclosed on every page.

## Core tools
- [The globe](https://gentlyyonder.com/globe.html): pick where you fly from and see the 22 cities Gently Yonder covers, nearest first by great-circle distance (rounded to 100 km), each with hotels, an eSIM, a flight search and our guides
- [Ready Score](https://gentlyyonder.com/#ready): destination readiness checklist, 36 destinations
- [eSIM Finder](https://gentlyyonder.com/tools/esim-finder.html): data-size and provider recommendation
- [Insurance Finder](https://gentlyyonder.com/tools/insurance-finder.html): coverage-type guidance
- [Checklist Generator](https://gentlyyonder.com/checklist-generator.html): full trip checklist
- [Destination Map](https://gentlyyonder.com/#map): world map of what we cover (gold: destination guides; pale gold: prep notes), with the globe as its default view

## Where to stay (hotel guides)
Each guide compares a city's areas first, then names hotels checked as open in September 2026, with the reason to choose each. Researched picks, not hosted stays; first-hand stays are labelled.
- [Where to Stay in Japan on a First Trip](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-japan.html): two bases, not four; nights per city for 5 to 12+ days, Tokyo to Kyoto moving day, luggage, lodging taxes
- [Where to Stay in Tokyo](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-tokyo.html): six areas (Shinjuku, Shibuya, Tokyo Station, Ginza, Asakusa, Ueno) and 17 hotels; choose the station first
- [Where to Stay in Kyoto](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-kyoto.html): downtown, Kyoto Station, Gion and Higashiyama, Arashiyama, the northern hills; 14 hotels and ryokan
- [Where to Stay in Kyoto for Cherry Blossom](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-kyoto-cherry-blossom.html): the Kyoto observatory's normal dates (first flowers 26 March, full bloom 4 April) and the 2025 and 2026 dates; when the first forecasts appear; five areas matched to the blossom walks (Okazaki, Gion and Higashiyama, downtown, Kyoto Station, Arashiyama) and 12 hotels; Kyoto's accommodation tax bands since 1 March 2026
- [Where to Stay in Tokyo for Cherry Blossom](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-tokyo-cherry-blossom.html): JMA dates (normal first flowers 24 March, full bloom 31 March; 2026: 19 and 28 March); five areas (Asakusa and the Sumida River, Ueno and Yanaka, Marunouchi and Hibiya, Shibuya, Shinjuku) and 14 hotels; Tokyo's accommodation tax becomes 3% on stays of ¥13,000 or more per person per night from 1 April 2027; Chidorigafuchi boat fees and Shinjuku Gyoen entry
- [Where to Stay in Sapporo for the Snow Festival](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-sapporo-snow-festival.html): the 2027 dates (4 to 11 February) and the three sites with hours (Odori lit until 10pm, Susukino until 11pm, Tsudome 10am to 4pm); four areas (Odori, Sapporo Station, Susukino, Nakajima Park) and 10 hotels; Sapporo and Hokkaido's accommodation tax since 1 April 2026 (¥300 to ¥1,000 a person a night); Sapporo Park Hotel closes on 28 February 2027
- [Where to Stay in Niseko](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-niseko.html): Niseko United's 2026/27 season by resort (from 28 November 2026; to 5 May 2027 at Grand Hirafu and Annupuri) and All Mountain Pass prices (¥13,500 peak, ¥12,600 regular, ¥8,800 early and spring); five areas (Grand Hirafu, HANAZONO, Niseko Village, Annupuri, Kutchan town) and 10 hotels; the 3% accommodation tax in Kutchan (since 1 April 2026) and Niseko Town (from 1 November 2026); Midtown Niseko becomes Mercure Niseko Resort in November 2026
- [Where to Stay in Fukuoka](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-fukuoka.html): four areas (Hakata Station, Nakasu and Canal City, Tenjin, Momochi) and 11 hotels; the airport subway (5 minutes to Hakata, 11 to Tenjin, ¥260); the Fukuoka City and prefecture hotel tax (¥200 under ¥20,000 a person a night, ¥500 from ¥20,000, since April 2020); the Kyushu Fukko Ouen-wari discount after the 28 July 2026 Kumamoto earthquake (50% off stays from 1 October to 15 December 2026, up to ¥20,000 a person a trip, open to overseas visitors, through listed Japanese booking sites or registered hotels, not Booking.com); the yatai areas (Nakasu, Tenjin, Nagahama)
- [Where to Stay in Kyoto for Autumn Leaves](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-kyoto-autumn-leaves.html): the Kyoto observatory's maple colouring normal (5 December; 10 December in 2025, 20 December in 2024, the latest on record) and the 2026 forecasts; Eikan-do's 2026 autumn opening (11 November to 6 December, ¥1,500) and light-up (20 November to 6 December, ¥1,000); Tofuku-ji's autumn period (14 November to 6 December, Tsuten-kyo ¥1,000, from 8.30am); Kodai-ji's night opening (23 October to 13 December, to 10pm, ¥800); five areas (Okazaki, Gion and Higashiyama, Kyoto Station, downtown, Arashiyama), 12 hotels and Kyoto's accommodation tax bands

- [Where to Stay in Tokyo for Autumn Leaves](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-tokyo-autumn-leaves.html): JMA Tokyo normals (ginkgo yellow 23 November, maple red 28 November; 2025: 22 and 23 November; 2024: both 3 December) and the 2026 forecasts (Jingu Gaien late November to early December, Rikugien early to mid-December); Rikugien's evening opening (25 November to 6 December 2026, ¥1,000 advance, ¥1,200 on the day); Shinjuku Gyoen's autumn hours (9am to 4.30pm, closed Mondays except 1 to 15 November, ¥500); the Jingu Gaien ginkgo avenue and its redevelopment; four areas (Shinjuku, Shibuya and Aoyama, Ueno, Marunouchi) and 11 hotels

- [Where to Stay in London (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-london.html): Covent Garden, the South Bank, South Kensington, Shoreditch and King's Cross, 12 hotels, the 20% VAT with no city tax yet (a visitor levy is planned in England but not set for London), the UK ETA, and Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted rail fares.
- [Where to Stay in Prague (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-prague.html): the Old Town, Malá Strana, the New Town, Vinohrady, Karlín and Holešovice, 12 hotels, the 50 CZK a night city fee, and the line 59, Airport Express and PID ticket fares.
- [Where to Stay in Venice (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-venice.html): San Marco, Castello, Dorsoduro, Cannaregio, Santa Croce and Mestre, 12 hotels, the tourist tax by star rating and zone (up to €5 a night), the 2026 day-tripper access fee and hotel-guest exemption, and the Alilaguna, Aerobus and vaporetto fares.
- [Where to Stay in Florence (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-florence.html): the Duomo, Santa Croce and Borgo Pinti, Santo Spirito, San Niccolò, Santa Maria Novella and San Lorenzo, 12 hotels, the city tax of €3.50 to €8 a person a night for up to seven nights, and the T2 airport tram and PisaMover fares.
- [Where to Stay in Barcelona (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-barcelona.html): six areas from the Eixample to Poble-sec, 12 hotels, the Catalan tourist tax plus Barcelona's surcharge (€8.40 a person a night at a four-star from April 2026), and the Aerobús, R2 Nord and L9 Sud from the airport.
- [Where to Stay in Rome (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-rome.html): the Centro Storico, the Spanish Steps, Monti, Trastevere, Prati and Termini, 12 hotels, the city tax of €4 to €10 a person a night by star rating, and the Leonardo Express, FL1 and Ciampino Airlink fares.
- [Where to Stay in Amsterdam (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-amsterdam.html): the Canal Ring, Jordaan, Museum Quarter, De Pijp, Centraal and Noord, 12 hotels, the 12.5% tourist tax on top of 21% VAT, and the Schiphol train and 397 bus fares.
- [Hotel Taxes Around the World (2026)](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/hotel-taxes-around-the-world-2026.html): what is added to a hotel room in Paris (taxe de séjour per person per night from 1 January 2026: €2.60 to €15.93, €8.45 at a four-star; minors exempt), New York City (14.75% plus $3.50 a room a night, so a $300 room costs $347.75), Tokyo (¥100 or ¥200 a person a night until 31 March 2027, then 3% on stays of ¥13,000 or more per person), Kyoto (¥200 to ¥10,000 a person a night since 1 March 2026), Osaka (¥200 to ¥500), Fukuoka (¥200 or ¥500), Sapporo with Hokkaido (¥300 to ¥1,000), Niseko (¥100 to ¥2,000, then 3% from 1 November 2026), Kutchan (3%), Nagano Prefecture (¥200, ¥300 from 1 June 2029) and Hakuba (¥200 to ¥1,900), Hong Kong (3% Hotel Accommodation Tax; the usual 10% service charge is not taxed), Singapore (9% GST on top of the 10% service charge, about 19.9%), Malaysia (8% service tax plus RM10 tourism tax a room a night for foreign guests), Korea's VAT refund on room charges at designated hotels, Taiwan's 10% service charge, and Japan's ¥3,000 departure tax on the ticket; every figure checked at an official source in October 2026
- [Tourist Taxes Around the World 2026: City-by-City Data](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/tourist-taxes-around-the-world-2026-data.html): the tourist, city and hotel occupancy tax in 85 cities, each rule as published, what it adds to one standard stay (3 nights, 2 adults, a US$200 room; Chicago about US$104, Washington DC about US$96, Paris about US$57, Amsterdam US$75), cities with none (Copenhagen, Dublin, London, Madrid, Stockholm), changes scheduled for 2026-27 (Tokyo 3% from April 2027, Vienna 8% from July 2027, Okinawa from February 2027, Barcelona's rising surcharge), official sources and check dates; free to cite with a link; CSV at https://gentlyyonder.com/data/tourist-taxes-2026.csv
- [Where to Stay in Osaka](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-osaka.html): Namba or Umeda, plus Nakanoshima, Tennoji and the bay for Universal Studios Japan; 10 hotels
- [Where to Stay in Hakone](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-hakone.html): five areas (Hakone-Yumoto, Miyanoshita, Gora, Sengokuhara, Lake Ashi) and 12 ryokan and hotels; which have a private open-air bath in every room; Freepass prices and the luggage service
- [Where to Stay in Seoul](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-seoul.html): five areas (Myeongdong, Jongno and Insadong, Hongdae, Seoul Station and Itaewon, Gangnam) and 12 hotels; Lotte Hotel Seoul renamed The Grand Lotte Seoul in August 2026; AREX express fare and times
- [Where to Stay in Bangkok](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-bangkok.html): five areas (Sukhumvit from Nana to Phrom Phong, Siam and Ratchaprasong, the Riverside, Silom and Sathorn, the Old Town) and 12 hotels; the rebuilt Dusit Thani (opened 27 September 2024) and its old listing; Airport Rail Link and Red Line fares; what "++" adds to Thai hotel prices
- [Where to Stay in Hong Kong](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-hong-kong.html): five areas (Tsim Sha Tsui, Central and Admiralty, Wan Chai and Causeway Bay, Sheung Wan, Jordan and Mong Kok) and 12 hotels; The Park Lane's move to Marriott's Autograph Collection in January 2025; Airport Express fares and the end of its free hotel shuttles; the 3% hotel tax charged again since 1 January 2025
- [Where to Stay in Singapore](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-singapore.html): five areas (Marina Bay and the Civic District, the Singapore River, Orchard Road, Chinatown and Tanjong Pagar, Sentosa) and 12 hotels; Hilton Singapore Orchard is the former Mandarin Orchard; Marina Bay Sands' rebuilt rooms; what "++" adds (10% service charge, then 9% GST on it); the free SG Arrival Card
- [Where to Stay in Taipei](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-taipei.html): five areas (Taipei Main Station and Zhongshan, Ximending, Xinyi, Da'an and the East District, Beitou) and 12 hotels, including two with a hot-spring bath in every room; the online Taiwan Arrival Card since 1 October 2025; the customary 10% service charge
- [Where to Stay in Kuala Lumpur](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-kuala-lumpur.html): four areas (KLCC, Bukit Bintang, the old city and Chinatown, KL Sentral) and 12 hotels, including Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur in Merdeka 118 (opened 7 August 2025); the KLIA Ekspres (28 minutes); the RM10 tourism tax and 8% service tax; the free Malaysia Digital Arrival Card
- [Where to Stay in Sydney](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney.html): six areas and 13 hotels; the Sheraton Grand Sydney Hyde Park is a first-hand stay (September 2026)
- [Where to Stay in Sydney for New Year's Eve](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-years-eve.html): the City of Sydney's 2026 running order (fireworks at 9pm and midnight); 48 vantage points with entry, ticket dates and alcohol rules; Circular Quay Station closed from 3pm to midnight; four areas (Circular Quay and The Rocks, Darling Harbour and Barangaroo, the city centre, North Sydney) and 12 hotels; minimum stays (YHA Sydney Harbour: 7 nights)
- [Where to Stay in Melbourne](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/where-to-stay-in-melbourne.html): the CBD inside the Free Tram Zone, Southbank, Fitzroy, St Kilda, South Yarra; 12 hotels
- [Hotel Booking Sites Compared](https://gentlyyonder.com/articles/hotel-booking-sites-comparison.html): Booking.com, Hotels.com, Trip.com, Agoda and HotelsCombined, and which loyalty scheme applies where
